# Mediabunny 1.61.3

Unmodified browser bundle from the npm `mediabunny@1.61.3` package.
Source: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/v1.61.3
Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.61.3.tgz
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0; see mediabunny-LICENSE.txt.

Loaded locally on Share replay, exclusively to encode/mux H.264/AAC MP4 with
WebCodecs. No CDN, new Discord mapping, network upload, or encoder runs in gameplay.
